newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Continental eyeing Aerolineas Argentinas - report.
newsitem.headline: Continental eyeing Aerolineas Argentinas - report.

text.p: Continental Airlines of the United States is considering buying a share in Aerolineas Argentinas, Argentine newspaper La Nacion reported Wednesday.
La Nacion quoted unidentified sources as saying Continental was interested in buying into Argentina's flag carrier and that top firm executives would visit Argentina next week.
Continental did not immediately respond to requests for comment, and Aerolineas had no comment on the report.

Brazil's VASP said earlier Wednesday that it was seeking to take a controlling stake in Aerolineas and that it had sent a letter to Spain's Iberia, which currently owns 20 percent of the Argentine airline.
The largest, 63.35-percent, stake in Aerolineas belongs to Andes Holding, which is owned by Merrill Lynch, Bankers Trust, and the Spanish government's holding company Teneo.
